_formula: Identity + Core Traits + Clothing + Pose + Camera + Background (+ constant style block). '@path' tokens are replaced verbatim from 'blocks' to prevent design drift.

blocks.ref_note: Reference image attached: keep this exact character design - same face, same silver hair, same ice-blue eyes, same outfit and colors

kaelan.identity: Kaelan, a lean 19-year-old anime young man
kaelan.core_traits: short messy silver-white hair with sharp spiky bangs falling between his eyes, piercing ice-blue eyes, pale skin, sharp jawline, slim athletic build
kaelan.clothing: black high-collar tactical jacket with silver buckles and crossing straps, a tattered dark-teal scarf around his neck, black fingerless gloves, dark grey cargo pants, worn brown combat boots

weasel.identity: Shadow Weasel, a small fox-sized weasel-like anime monster
weasel.core_traits: sleek elongated body made of dark violet-black shadow fur with crisp clean cel-shaded outlines and purple rim highlights, two glowing crimson eyes, bared sharp white fangs, a long bushy tail, a small glowing violet crystal embedded in its forehead

world.meadow: the dawn meadow of Aethelgard: rolling hills of tall emerald grass and tiny white flowers, scattered moss-covered rocks, distant blue mountains, giant floating rock islands with waterfalls, golden-pink sunrise sky
world.forest_road: a dirt road along the edge of an ancient sunlit forest in Aethelgard, tall trees, bushes, warm golden afternoon light

style.anime: Style: high-end 2D action anime key visual in the style of Ufotable and MAPPA productions, crisp clean black lineart, cel shading with hard-edged two-tone shadows, vibrant saturated colors, hand-painted anime background art, cinematic lighting with soft bloom. Flat 2D anime cel look, not photorealistic, not 3D render, no hyper-realism. No text, no letters, no UI elements, no watermark, no frame border, full-bleed image without black letterbox bars

blocks.ref_note_multi: Reference images attached: keep these exact character designs - same faces, hair, eyes, outfits, colors and proportions. The references are design sheets only, not the scene layout

elara.identity: Elara, a 17-year-old anime girl, a young traveling merchant
elara.core_traits: long chestnut-brown hair tied in a loose side braid over her left shoulder, warm amber eyes, light freckles across her nose, slim build, gentle face
elara.clothing: cream linen blouse with rolled sleeves, forest-green hooded travel cloak with a bronze clasp, brown leather satchel with brass buckles worn across her body, brown corset belt, dark brown skirt over leggings, brown leather boots

goblin.identity: Goblin, a small hunched anime goblin monster about the height of a child
goblin.core_traits: olive-green skin, long pointed ears, glowing yellow eyes, sharp crooked teeth, ragged patched leather armor, a cracked glowing red gem amulet on its chest

CHAR_Kaelan_ref.pose: Character model sheet: on the left a full-body front view standing in a relaxed neutral pose with arms slightly away from the body, on the right a large head-and-shoulders close-up portrait of the same character looking at the viewer with a calm serious expression
CHAR_Kaelan_ref.camera: orthographic eye-level view, even framing, the entire figure visible from hair to boots with margin
CHAR_Kaelan_ref.background: plain flat light grey background, no environment, no ground shadow

S01_SH01_awakening_topdown.pose: lying on his back in the grass with arms loosely spread, eyes just opened, staring up at the sky with a dazed confused expression, a few grass blades and white petals on his jacket
S01_SH01_awakening_topdown.camera: top-down overhead shot directly above him, his body placed diagonally across the frame, face in the upper third, medium-wide framing
S01_SH01_awakening_topdown.background: a bed of tall emerald grass and tiny white flowers in @world.meadow, soft golden sunrise light from the top left

S01_SH02_puddle_reflection.pose: leaning forward over a puddle and looking straight down into the camera with wide surprised eyes and slightly parted lips, silver hair and the teal scarf hanging down toward the viewer
S01_SH02_puddle_reflection.camera: extreme worm's-eye view from directly below, as if seen from the water surface looking up at him, his face large in the center of the frame
S01_SH02_puddle_reflection.background: the bright golden-pink sunrise sky of Aethelgard with soft clouds behind his head, a few blades of wet grass framing the edges of the image
S01_SH02_puddle_reflection._note: v01 rejected: model drew an upside-down body instead of a reflection. v02 = what the reflection looks like (worm's-eye view, sky behind); the water surface is added in code.

S01_SH03_system_glow.pose: standing half-turned toward the left of the frame, right hand raised slightly in astonishment, staring at a floating light source on the left with wide eyes, his face lit by a cool cyan glow
S01_SH03_system_glow.camera: cinematic medium close-up from the chest up, character on the right third of the frame, empty space on the left third, slight low angle, shallow depth of field
S01_SH03_system_glow.background: @world.meadow softly blurred behind him, warm golden sunrise rim light on his hair from behind, cool cyan light on his face from the left

ENV_meadow_groundlevel.identity: Background art plate: a quiet clearing in @world.meadow
ENV_meadow_groundlevel.core_traits: tall emerald grass framing the left and right edges, a patch of flattened grass and bare earth in the center-right of the frame, scattered moss-covered rocks
ENV_meadow_groundlevel.pose: empty scene, no characters, no people, no animals, no creatures
ENV_meadow_groundlevel.camera: low ground-level wide shot, camera just above the grass tips, horizon in the upper third, deep perspective
ENV_meadow_groundlevel.background: distant blue mountains, giant floating rock islands with waterfalls, golden-pink sunrise sky with long clouds, warm backlight and light morning haze

CREA_ShadowWeasel_sprite.pose: low crouched aggressive hunting pose, snarling, ready to pounce, facing left
CREA_ShadowWeasel_sprite.camera: three-quarter side view at eye level, the entire body and tail fully visible and centered with generous margin, nothing cropped
CREA_ShadowWeasel_sprite.background: isolated on a plain solid pure white background, no ground, no cast shadow, no environment, no smoke outside the body silhouette

S03_SH01_throw_action.pose: frozen in a dynamic mid-throw action pose, right arm fully extended forward toward the right of the frame having just released a small grey stone, left arm swung back, torso twisted, one knee bent, scarf and silver hair whipping in the wind, fierce determined expression with narrowed ice-blue eyes
S03_SH01_throw_action.camera: dramatic low-angle three-quarter view, slight dutch tilt, strong foreshortening on the throwing hand, character facing screen right, full body in frame
S03_SH01_throw_action.background: @world.meadow, tall grass bending in the wind, flying petals, warm golden backlight with a bright sunrise flare behind him

S04_SH01_hero_analyse.pose: standing tall and calm with a faint confident smile, right hand raised to chest height palm up with small glowing cyan light motes gathering above it, scarf and silver hair blowing in the wind
S04_SH01_hero_analyse.camera: low-angle medium-wide hero shot, character centered, framed from the knees up, sun directly behind him creating a strong golden rim light
S04_SH01_hero_analyse.background: a grassy hilltop in @world.meadow, far away on the horizon a colossal dark obelisk-like monolith tower rising into the clouds, dramatic sunrise clouds

CHAR_Elara_ref.pose: Character model sheet: on the left a full-body front view standing in a relaxed neutral pose, on the right a large head-and-shoulders close-up portrait of the same character with a kind, slightly shy smile
CHAR_Elara_ref.camera: orthographic eye-level view, even framing, the entire figure visible from hair to boots with margin
CHAR_Elara_ref.background: plain flat light grey background, no environment, no ground shadow

CREA_Goblin_pair_sprite.pose: the left goblin raises a crude wooden club in a threatening stance, the right goblin crouches with clawed hands raised and a nasty grin; both face right; the two goblins stand clearly apart with wide empty space between them, not touching, not overlapping
CREA_Goblin_pair_sprite.camera: three-quarter side view at eye level, both full bodies completely visible with generous margin, nothing cropped
CREA_Goblin_pair_sprite.background: isolated on a plain solid pure white background, no ground, no cast shadow, no environment

CREA_ShadowWeasel_cute.core_traits: sleek elongated body made of dark violet-black shadow fur with crisp clean cel-shaded outlines and purple rim highlights, big round glossy crimson eyes, mouth closed, a small glowing violet crystal embedded in its forehead, a long fluffy tail
CREA_ShadowWeasel_cute.pose: sitting upright on its hind legs like a curious meerkat, head tilted, looking innocent and harmless, facing left
CREA_ShadowWeasel_cute.camera: side view at eye level, the entire body and tail fully visible and centered with generous margin, nothing cropped
CREA_ShadowWeasel_cute.background: isolated on a plain solid pure white background, no ground, no cast shadow, no environment

ENV_sky_pov.identity: Background art plate: point of view looking straight up into the sky while lying in the grass of @world.meadow
ENV_sky_pov.core_traits: tall emerald grass blades and tiny white flowers framing all edges of the image, several giant floating rock islands with long waterfalls high in the sky, a bright sun flare in the upper left, drifting white petals
ENV_sky_pov.pose: empty scene, no characters, no people, no animals
ENV_sky_pov.camera: extreme low worm's-eye view pointing straight up, wide angle
ENV_sky_pov.background: vast golden-pink sunrise sky with soft layered clouds

ENV_forest_road.core_traits: an overturned wooden merchant cart with a broken wheel on the right side of the road, spilled crates, red apples and cloth bundles, a simple iron-tipped wooden spear lying in the grass at the left roadside
ENV_forest_road.pose: empty scene, no characters, no people, no creatures
ENV_forest_road.camera: medium-wide shot at eye level, the road crossing the frame horizontally, clear open space in the center of the road
ENV_forest_road.background: tall ancient trees, dense bushes on the left side, distant hills, warm afternoon light beams

S05_SH01_goblin_tracks.identity: Background art plate: a muddy forest trail at the edge of @world.forest_road
S05_SH01_goblin_tracks.core_traits: fresh small clawed three-toed footprints pressed into the mud, broken twigs, a torn scrap of green cloth caught on a thorny bush
S05_SH01_goblin_tracks.pose: empty scene, no characters, no creatures
S05_SH01_goblin_tracks.camera: low angle close to the ground following the footprints into the distance, deep perspective
S05_SH01_goblin_tracks.background: tall ancient trees, golden afternoon light beams through the leaves, light haze

S01_SH03_eyes_ecu.pose: eyes just opened wide in wonder
S01_SH03_eyes_ecu.camera: extreme close-up of his eyes only, framed from the eyebrows to the bridge of the nose, ice-blue irises with the sky and floating islands reflected in them, silver hair strands falling across
S01_SH03_eyes_ecu.background: soft blurred green grass around his face

S01_SH04_hilltop_back.pose: standing alone on a grassy hilltop seen from behind, scarf and silver hair blowing in the wind, looking out over the world
S01_SH04_hilltop_back.camera: epic extreme wide shot from behind, he is small in the lower third of the frame
S01_SH04_hilltop_back.background: vast panorama of @world.meadow with a winding river valley, forests and giant floating islands with waterfalls under a sunrise sky

S01_SH05_hands.pose: looking down at his own raised open hands in black fingerless gloves, shocked and disbelieving expression
S01_SH05_hands.camera: close-up from slightly above and in front, both hands in sharp focus in the foreground, his face visible above them

S02_SH02_reach_out.pose: kneeling on one knee in the grass, extending his right hand gently toward the right of the frame with a soft friendly smile, as if to pet a small animal
S02_SH02_reach_out.camera: medium shot from the side at eye level, he is on the left half facing right, empty grass on the right half of the frame

S02_SH05_hand_stone.pose: his black fingerless-gloved right hand tightly gripping a fist-sized grey stone in the grass, knuckles tense
S02_SH05_hand_stone.camera: extreme close-up insert shot at ground level, shallow depth of field
S02_SH05_hand_stone.background: grass blades and tiny white flowers, the blurred dark silhouette of a small creature with glowing red eyes in the background

S05_SH04_kaelan_bushes.pose: crouching hidden behind leafy bushes, determined fierce expression with narrowed ice-blue eyes, a small grey stone in his right hand
S05_SH04_kaelan_bushes.camera: close-up from a low angle through leaves, foreground leaves softly blurred, his face lit by a sunbeam

S06_SH02_spear_thrust.pose: frozen mid-lunge thrusting a simple iron-tipped wooden spear forward toward the right of the frame with both hands, body stretched in a long dynamic stance, scarf and hair whipping back, intense focused eyes, a faint cyan glow trailing along the spear tip
S06_SH02_spear_thrust.camera: dramatic low-angle side view, strong perspective, character facing screen right, full body in frame
S06_SH02_spear_thrust.background: @world.forest_road, the overturned cart blurred in the background

S06_SH04_levelup.pose: standing upright on the road holding a simple wooden spear at his side, head slightly raised, eyes closed, calm, bathed in rising streams of golden and cyan light particles
S06_SH04_levelup.camera: medium shot from a low angle, character centered

S02_SH03_weasel_lunge.pose: frozen action moment: the Shadow Weasel leaps at Kaelan mid-air from the right with claws extended and fangs bared, Kaelan falls backward onto the grass raising his left forearm to shield himself, one jacket sleeve torn by the claws, shocked expression; no blood, no wounds
S02_SH03_weasel_lunge.camera: dynamic low-angle side view with a dutch tilt, both characters fully in frame, motion lines

S05_SH03_elara_threatened.pose: Elara kneels with her back against an overturned wooden merchant cart, frightened, clutching her satchel; the two goblins advance toward her from the left, one raising a crude wooden club
S05_SH03_elara_threatened.camera: medium-wide shot at eye level, Elara on the right, the goblins in the center-left seen in three-quarter view from behind
S05_SH03_elara_threatened.background: @world.forest_road with spilled crates and red apples

S06_SH03_dodge.pose: frozen bullet-time moment: the GOBLIN on the right swings its crude wooden club with both of its own hands in a wide horizontal arc; Kaelan on the left, holding a simple wooden spear low in one hand, leans far back so the goblin's club passes just above his face; his ice-blue eyes calmly track the club; Kaelan's hands do not touch the club
S06_SH03_dodge.camera: close side view at eye level, Kaelan on the left facing right, the goblin on the right facing left, the club between them, motion streaks along the club's arc
S06_SH03_dodge._note: v01 rejected: Kaelan was holding the club himself, the goblin was empty-handed.

S07_SH01_elara_thanks.pose: kneeling beside the overturned cart, looking up with relieved, slightly teary eyes and a warm grateful smile, one hand on her chest
S07_SH01_elara_thanks.camera: close-up from a slight high angle, as seen by the person standing in front of her
S07_SH01_elara_thanks.background: @world.forest_road, floating light motes, soft warm light

S07_SH02_walking_together.pose: Kaelan and Elara walk side by side along a dirt road away from the camera, Kaelan carries a simple wooden spear over his shoulder, Elara points ahead with a smile
S07_SH02_walking_together.camera: wide shot from behind, both characters small in the lower center of the frame
S07_SH02_walking_together.background: the road winds through golden hills toward a distant sunset, far away on the horizon a colossal dark obelisk-like monolith tower rises into the clouds
